question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.
sql:
-- Final verification: let me also check without rounding to see full precision
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT pr.player_id,
           pr.total_runs,
           pm.matches_played,
           pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pm.matches_played as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs pr
    JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
)
SELECT p.country_name,
       AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) as country_avg_runs_per_match
FROM player_avg pa
JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id

),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT pr.player_id,
           pr.total_runs,
           pm.matches_played,
           CASE WHEN pm.matches_played > 0 THEN pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pm.matches_played ELSE 0 END as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs pr
    JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
